subject: Lint rule for hint-penalty fragility in the non-BoxEngine engines (config-shared.js boxes)
description: Chris made filing this a CONDITION of accepting that box-contract-lint.js correctly scopes to BoxEngine boxes rather than stretching to cover these - an unfiled 'I will build a separate rule' evaporates once the branch merges, and this is the same defect class that already cost two review rounds. OpenWorldEngine.js and LagrangeEngine.js are separate engines whose boxes (arena/boxes/ow-*, ows-*, le-*) declare config in config-shared.js, which box-contract-lint.js does not read - its rules (dir/cd consistency, cls fallthrough, hint label numeracy) are BoxEngine-shaped. Both engines were fixed defensively under task 378 (numeric guards, latent not live - every ow/ows/le config carries a numeric hintPenalty today), but NOTHING WILL CATCH A REGRESSION: an author adding hintPenalty: 0 or a non-numeric value to a config-shared.js box gets no warning from any gate. Needs its own small rule reading config-shared.js and asserting every scoring value the engines consume is numeric. Also worth checking those engines for the other contract classes (a command returning null, a shell advertising what it cannot open) since they were never audited for them at all.
activeForm: Working on: Lint rule for hint-penalty fragility in the non-BoxEngine engines (config-shared.js boxes)
